disclosure: This is an internal design and tuning regression set, not an independently authored benchmark and not evidence of general model or search quality. Its labels were written by the same process that selected the ranking algorithm, and the router thresholds were fitted on it. Do not publish these numbers as independent evaluation.
purpose: Pin the behaviour of pae_engine.SearchEngine and pae_engine.Router against the live registry so a ranking or routing regression is caught in CI.

label_sources.claude_md_routing_table: Derived from the hand-written "user phrase" -> resource mappings that already existed in CLAUDE.md before Phase 4. Those mappings predate the search implementation and were not produced by any algorithm under test. Query text was paraphrased into natural user language so a case does not simply echo its target's title.
label_sources.registry_record_sample: Hand-authored during Phase 4 against a sampled registry record, because CLAUDE.md's tables target prompts almost exclusively and supply no labels for skills, agents, commands, personas or techniques.
label_sources.registry_relationship: Derived from an explicit copy_of relationship in the registry.
label_sources.phase4_regression_judgment: Hand-authored Phase 4 regression judgment. Acceptable scopes and kinds are deliberately permissive where the corpus genuinely supports several answers.

notes: acceptable_* lists are permissive: any listed value counts as correct.
An empty acceptable_* list means that dimension is not scored for the case.
Scopes are expressed in the Phase 4 scope vocabulary, in which agentic-resources is split one level deeper (agentic-resources/<category>).
